$comment: PCI DSS 4.0.1 req. 6.4.3 inventory of every script loaded on pages that initiate payment. Each entry needs a business justification. scripts/verify-payment-scripts.mjs fails the build if the built page loads a script that is not listed here or whose integrity hash changed.

scripts.justification: First-party application bundle (routing, checkout redirect to the PSP's hosted page). Card data is never collected by this bundle.
First-party theme bootstrap: reads the saved light/dark choice before the app paints. No network, no payment data.
